integrity: The proof is an independent vertex-degree case analysis. Computations are finite corroboration only; no external validation, independent certificate, or authorship is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts; no claim for arbitrary graphs. Empty graph assigned strong domination number zero. Published same-parameter assertions for balanced subclasses conflict with explicitly checked instances; independent external audit remains unperformed.
title: Sharp strong-domination stability of complete multipartite graphs and optimal deletion witnesses
